title: Financial Analyst
summary: Financial analyst with 5 years of experience in FP&A, budgeting, and data-driven reporting. Built Excel and SQL-based models that reduced monthly reporting time and supported $80M in capital allocation decisions.

responsibilities: Built a monthly FP&A dashboard in Tableau consolidating data from 4 source systems for 12 business units
Wrote SQL queries against Snowflake data warehouse to automate 6 recurring financial reports, saving 20 hours per month
Created a Python script to validate and clean 18 months of legacy transaction data before migration
Developed Excel-based financial models supporting portfolio allocation across 14 funds
Produced weekly variance analysis reports distributed to 8 senior stakeholders
Coordinated with IT to migrate 3 years of historical P&L data into Salesforce
